tldr: Continuous-dose effects admit interpretable weighted derivative summaries, but an optimal population weight must itself be learned. In the Gaussian parent with public \(\beta\in(1/6,1/4)\), the exact original-data local minimax squared-risk value is \(V_4=D^{-1}+(14/3)J\), exceeding the ordinary canonical variance by \((8/3)J\). A lawful joint Gaussian experiment gives the all-procedure converse, while one universal total estimator attains a uniform squared-error influence expansion with feasible studentization. A curvature frontier separates every shrinking near-affine slice from fixed curved neighborhoods. The target and the parametric rate are inherited; the sharp efficiency price and its original-data attainment are the contribution.
gap: Existing optimal-weight and Gaussian fourth-moment results do not establish the exact all-procedure risk of learning this population derivative weight over the specified rough parent. General nonlinear-scale priority remains a bounded-search uncertainty.
